svg.text: Target Architecture for High-Concurrency, Event-Driven, Multi-Region Vacation Rental Systems
Production target architecture | Current implementation: React/Vite + Java 21 Spring Boot 3.3.4

g.text: SPA · Photo Tour · Sticky Nav · Modals
Edge CDN & Web Application Firewall (CloudFront / Cloudflare)
Global Anycast Network · 300+ Edge Points of Presence (PoPs)
Path-based routing · SSL offloading · Request tracing injection
Tiered quotas: IP-level, User-level, Route-level limits
Stateless cryptographic JWT validation · Role-Based Access Control
Aggregates listing, host, ratings & quotes in single client roundtrip
Containerized in Docker · Orchestrated via Kubernetes (Amazon EKS) · Horizontal Pod Autoscaled
Triggers payments, calendar sync, host email
Syncs modified listing data to Elasticsearch
Settlement, refund on cancel, ledger updates
• Tables: listings, hosts, rooms, amenities, bookings, reviews
• Read-replicas for heavy listing and review read traffic
• Strict foreign keys, composite indexes, JSONB for amenities
• Distributed locks for concurrent date booking (Redlock)
• Hot listing cache (TTL: 15 min with stale-while-revalidate)
• User session store & sticky auth cache
Cluster Mode enabled with automatic failover
• Geo-distance shapes & bounding box filtering (Goa, Candolim)
• Fast faceted aggregations (price ranges, guest counts)
• Fuzzy text matching across descriptions & reviews
• Near-real-time index updates synced via Kafka consumers
• Pre-signed URL uploads for verified hosts
• Direct origin integration to Edge CDN (CloudFront)
Multi-AZ EKS cluster · Docker container images
• Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) driven by CPU/custom metrics
• Rolling blue-green & canary deployment zero-downtime updates
• Automated Maven compile & JUnit test execution
• TypeScript build check & container image vulnerability scan
• Correlates request trace IDs from client to microservices to DB
• Exports standardized spans and metrics to Jaeger & Prometheus
• P95/P99 latency tracking, JVM memory & HTTP 5xx alert rules
• Grafana dashboards for booking throughput & cache hit rates
